purpose: Compare the materialized Korean-sheet normal Hero talent localization against the current FINAL_FROZEN Hero talent consumer by HeroID, without recomputing Hero semantics.

classification.DIRECT_REUSE_STRONG: After ignoring localization-only numeric sign/percent notation, the ordered numeric signatures agree at stars 3-6.
classification.REUSE_CANDIDATE_STRUCTURE_ONLY: The normalized numeric value sets agree at stars 3-6 but order or repetition count differs; retain as a light-review reuse candidate.
classification.REVIEW_NUMERIC_DRIFT: At least one star contains a normalized numeric value that is absent on the other side; do not reuse the old KR description without review.
classification.MANUAL_REVIEW: Current frozen talent structure cannot be deterministically aligned by the existing star-selection contract.
